  "title": "Implement GetSerialNumber from the Certificater interface for the pkg/certificate/providers/tresor component ",
  "body": "For GitHub Issue https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/issues/2311 we need to use `GetSerialNumber()`, which is not implemented for `./pkg/certificate/providers/tresor`\r\n\r\nHere is the current implementation of the function with a `panic`: https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/blob/1e0ba082581eff0c11d72098dbec5ce3267263ce/pkg/certificate/providers/tresor/certificate.go#L43\r\n\r\nThe SerialNumber is generated here:  https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/blob/7944a11844f2f01b97880e4369cc488cacc27e71/pkg/certificate/providers/tresor/certificate_manager.go#L29\r\n\r\nWe can add it to the Certificate struct here:  https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/blob/7944a11844f2f01b97880e4369cc488cacc27e71/pkg/certificate/providers/tresor/certificate_manager.go#L80-L86\r\n\r\nBut before that we need to actually add the field to the `Certificate` struct: https://github.com/openservicemesh/osm/blob/1e0ba082581eff0c11d72098dbec5ce3267263ce/pkg/certificate/providers/tresor/types.go#L49-L62\r\n\r\nI (@draychev) would vote for the `SerialNumber` field to be `string`.\r\n",

      "body": "> I (@draychev) would vote for the `SerialNumber` field to be `string`.\r\n\r\n@draychev serial number is currently generated as *Big.Int, do you mean we should convert it to string as it is generated or assigned as a field in cert (see commit [here](https://github.com/SanyaKochhar/osm/commit/d3d544c3fd868fda46024111107ae84a77250989)) or have getSerialNumber return it as a string? "
